linux.title: Linux Track
linux.subtitle: Linux Fundamentals & Command Line Operations
linux.description: Master navigation, file operations, searching, permissions, and process management inside real Linux environments.

module1.title: Linux Navigation
module1.story: Orientation day. IT dropped you into a workstation with a maze of folders. Prove you can find your way around.
module1.mission: Locate the onboarding key hidden inside your home directory.

objectives.label: Print your current directory with pwd
Read the hidden key file with cat

hints: Hint 1: Use `pwd` to check your location, then `ls -la` to reveal hidden files.
Hint 2: Navigate to `records/logs/archive` using `cd` and inspect `.keyfile` with `cat`.

module2.title: File Operations
module2.story: Clean up your workspace: organize inbox files, move drafts, and backup key manifests.
module2.mission: Create a backup directory, copy the manifest, move final drafts, and clean temp files.
hints: Hint 1: Use `mkdir -p workspace/backup` and `cp inbox/manifest.txt workspace/backup/`.
Hint 2: Move files using `mv inbox/draft.txt workspace/final.txt` and check `.vault/.key`.

module3.title: Text Processing & Line Counting
module3.story: A web server log was flooded with duplicate traffic entries during a system breach. Analyze log line counts and isolate the anomaly.
module3.mission: Analyze server logs using wc, sort, uniq, and cut to isolate the access key.

objectives.label: Count lines in server.log using wc -l
Sort and aggregate unique entries with sort and uniq
Extract specific key columns using cut or awk

hints: Hint 1: Count log records with `wc -l data/server.log`.
Hint 2: Sort and count unique lines using `sort data/server.log | uniq -c` and extract key with `cut -d':' -f2`.

module4.title: Archive Extraction & Binary Inspection
module4.story: An legacy backup archive contains encrypted binary blobs and encoded metadata. Decompress the tarball, inspect binary strings, and decode base64.
module4.mission: Decompress backup.tar.gz, inspect file types, extract printable strings, and decode base64.

objectives.label: Inspect file headers using file utility
Extract printable strings from binary blob using strings

hints: Hint 1: Extract files using `tar -xzf backup.tar.gz` and check types using `file extracted/*`.
Hint 2: Extract text using `strings extracted/blob.dat` and decode payload with `base64 -d`.

module5.title: System Diagnostics & Stream Redirection
module5.story: A rogue background process modified environment variables and system config files. Compare config diffs, locate running PIDs, and redirect metrics.
module5.mission: Inspect environment variables, compare file diffs, identify process PID, and redirect output.

objectives.label: Inspect active environment variables with env
Locate rogue background process with ps aux
Chain utilities and redirect stream output to result.txt

hints: Hint 1: Inspect environment with `env` and compare files using `diff config.old config.new`.
Hint 2: Find PID with `ps aux | grep runaway` and redirect processed key output using `cat .final/key.txt > result.txt`.

python.title: Python Track
python.subtitle: Python Syntax & Automation Programming
python.description: Learn Python programming: variables, string operations, loops, dictionaries, file I/O, and exception handling.

module1.title: Python Variables & Data Types
module1.story: Orientation day in Python workstation. Inspect variables in main.py and execute script to verify environment.
module1.mission: Execute main.py with python3 and inspect variables to output the module key.
hints: Hint 1: Check Python installation with `python3 --version`.
Hint 2: Inspect code with `cat main.py` and run using `python3 main.py`.

module2.title: Conditionals & Strings
module2.story: Security team needs access token validation. Inspect security.py and parse tokens to reveal key.
module2.mission: Complete security.py to parse access tokens and output the verified key.

objectives.label: Execute python3 security.py to print flag

hints: Hint 1: Inspect parsing logic in `security.py` using `cat security.py`.
Hint 2: Run `python3 security.py` to validate tokens and output key.

module3.title: Code Flow & Multi-Module Imports
module3.story: A data pipeline consists of modular scripts (analytics.py, data_loader.py). Trace function calls across modules using grep and execute analytics.py.
module3.mission: Trace imports across data_loader.py and calculator.py, and execute python3 analytics.py.

objectives.label: List workspace Python modules with ls
Search for imported helper methods with grep
Execute python3 analytics.py to compute metrics

hints: Hint 1: Trace imported functions with `grep -n 'import' *.py`.
Hint 2: Inspect `data_loader.py` and run `python3 analytics.py`.

module4.title: Configuration Files & JSON Parsing
module4.story: An API gateway reads sensitive keys from structured JSON config files and environment variables. Inspect nested JSON structure and run app.py.
module4.mission: Inspect config.json, verify environment key resolution, and execute python3 app.py.

objectives.label: Inspect active environment settings with env or export
Execute python3 app.py to output secret key

hints: Hint 1: Read JSON file using `cat config.json`.
Hint 2: Check environment variables with `env` and execute `python3 app.py`.

module5.title: Exception Tracing & Error Handling
module5.story: An automated service crashes due to unhandled exceptions when processing corrupted log payloads. Trace exception handlers and execute runner.py safely.
module5.mission: Trace exception handlers, process safe fallback logic, and run python3 runner.py.

objectives.label: Inspect exception handling logic in runner.py
Search for exception handlers with grep
Verify try-except block in handler script
Execute python3 runner.py to output flag

hints: Hint 1: Search exception blocks using `grep -n 'except' runner.py`.
Hint 2: Execute `python3 runner.py` to process log stream safely.

java.title: Java Track
java.subtitle: Object-Oriented & Java Application Architecture
java.description: Learn Java programming: class structure, array iteration, static methods, class inheritance, file stream I/O, and properties configuration.

module1.title: Java Program Structure & Main
module1.story: Compile Main.java with javac and run java Main to output module flag.
module1.mission: Compile Main.java with javac and run java Main to output module flag.

objectives.label: Compile source code with javac Main.java
Execute java Main to print flag

hints: Hint 1: Verify compiler with `javac -version`.
Hint 2: Compile code with `javac Main.java` and execute with `java Main`.

module2.title: Control Flow & Array Iteration
module2.story: Complete ControlFlow.java to iterate through code array and output the flag.
module2.mission: Complete ControlFlow.java to iterate through code array and output the flag.

objectives.label: Execute java ControlFlow to print flag

hints: Hint 1: Inspect array logic using `cat ControlFlow.java`.
Hint 2: Compile with `javac ControlFlow.java` and run `java ControlFlow`.

module3.title: Package Structure & Static Utility Classes
module3.story: An enterprise Java service uses modular package structure (com.cyber.utils.SecurityHelper). Locate package source files using find, compile, and run App.
module3.mission: Navigate package structure, compile Java package, and execute java com.cyber.App.

objectives.label: Locate package Java files using find . -name '*.java'
Search for static utility methods with grep
Compile package source files with javac com/cyber/*.java
Execute java com.cyber.App to print flag

hints: Hint 1: Search Java package sources with `find . -name '*.java'`.
Hint 2: Compile package with `javac com/cyber/*.java` and run `java com.cyber.App`.

module4.title: Class Inheritance & Object Instantiation
module4.story: An object-oriented vault service uses sub-class inheritance (SecureVault extends Vault). Inspect class definitions, compile all classes, and run VaultApp.
module4.mission: Inspect inherited class definitions, compile *.java, and execute java VaultApp.

objectives.label: Compile all Java classes with javac *.java
Execute java VaultApp to output key

hints: Hint 1: Inspect inheritance structure using `cat SecureVault.java`.
Hint 2: Compile with `javac *.java` and execute `java VaultApp`.

module5.title: Resource Handling & Properties Configuration
module5.story: A Java application loads configuration settings from app.properties via java.util.Properties. Inspect resource properties, compile ConfigLoader, and run.
module5.mission: Inspect app.properties, compile ConfigLoader.java, and execute java ConfigLoader.

objectives.label: Inspect app.properties resource file with cat
Execute java ConfigLoader to display flag

hints: Hint 1: Read properties file using `cat app.properties`.
Hint 2: Compile with `javac ConfigLoader.java` and execute `java ConfigLoader`.

c.title: C Programming Track
c.subtitle: Low-Level C Programming & Artifact Investigation
c.description: Master C programming: compilation, conditionals, memory arrays, header files, binary string inspection, and struct deserialization.

module1.title: C Program Syntax & printf
module1.story: Compile main.c with gcc and run ./main executable to print module key.
module1.mission: Compile main.c with gcc and run ./main executable to print module key.

objectives.label: Compile main.c with gcc -o main main.c

hints: Hint 1: Check compiler with `gcc --version`.
Hint 2: Compile with `gcc -o main main.c` and execute `./main`.

module2.title: Variables & Conditionals
module2.story: Modify calc.c to evaluate security levels and output key binary.
module2.mission: Modify calc.c to evaluate security levels and output key binary.
hints: Hint 1: Read source with `cat calc.c`.
Hint 2: Compile with `gcc -o calc calc.c` and run `./calc`.

module3.title: Header Files & Macro Definitions
module3.story: A C telemetry application splits configuration across header files (config.h, app.c). Inspect macro definitions, compile app.c, and run executable.
module3.mission: Inspect config.h header definitions, compile with gcc -o app app.c, and execute ./app.

objectives.label: Inspect config.h header definitions with cat or grep
Compile C application with gcc -o app app.c

hints: Hint 1: Read header file using `cat config.h`.
Hint 2: Compile using `gcc -o app app.c` and execute `./app`.

module4.title: Binary Inspection & String Extraction
module4.story: A compiled binary artifact contains embedded ASCII symbols and character tables. Inspect file header types with file, extract strings, and run decoder.
module4.mission: Inspect binary file type with file, extract printable text with strings, and run ./decoder.

objectives.label: Inspect binary artifact file type using file
Extract printable character symbols using strings
Compile decoder source with gcc -o decoder decoder.c

hints: Hint 1: Inspect binary header using `file artifact.bin`.
Hint 2: Extract text using `strings artifact.bin` and run `./decoder`.

module5.title: Struct Deserialization & Binary File I/O
module5.story: A system daemon deserializes structured records from binary files (data.bin). Inspect record layout in structs.c, compile, and execute.
module5.mission: Inspect struct layout in structs.c, compile with gcc -o structs structs.c, and execute ./structs.

objectives.label: Inspect binary file data.bin using stat or ls -l
Compile C source with gcc -o structs structs.c

hints: Hint 1: Inspect file structure using `cat structs.c` and check binary file size with `ls -l data.bin`.
Hint 2: Compile with `gcc -o structs structs.c` and execute `./structs`.
